text:
Type: white pintucked lumbar cushion
Use: back support and decoration on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: textured cotton-linen fabric, stitched pin tucks, frayed ruffle trim
Colors: white
Shape: rectangular cushion with a central band of vertical pin tucks, soft ruffled edges on the short sides, gentle wrinkled texture, medium size
Feel: soft, romantic, fresh, calm
Goes with: white or linen bedding, light wood, pastel tones, lace and cotton; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian bedrooms

product.name: VITFJRIL
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
